sources.title: roberta-base: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview roberta-base is a bidirectional transformer model pretrained on 160GB of English text using masked language modeling, created by FacebookAI. The model randomly masks 15% of input tokens during pretraining and learns to predict them, which differs from GPT-style models that mask future tokens.
